

```{r}
# might take a while, took 1-2 min on my system
# works on container
tigercensus_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/tigercensuscodes.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
determinants_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/social_determinants.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
providers_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/providers.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
patients_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/patients.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
encounters_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/encounters.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
diagnosis_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/diagnosis.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)
departments_raw <- read_csv('~/data/2026-ASA-DataFest-Data-Files/departments.csv',show_col_types = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#| label: departments_cleaning
#| eval: false

clean_df <- function(df) {
  return(df |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
     mutate(across(everything(), \(x) ifelse(str_detect(x, "\\*|Unknown|Unspecified"), NA, x)))
  )
}

departments <- clean_df(departments_raw) |>
  filter(department_key > 0)
determinants <- clean_df(determinants_raw) 
encounters <- clean_df(encounters_raw) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"), visit_type = str_to_title(visit_type))
diagnosis <- clean_df(diagnosis_raw)
patients <- clean_df(patients_raw)
providers <- clean_df(providers_raw) |>
  mutate(across(-c(durable_key, clinician_title), \(x) str_to_title(x)), 
         office_address = str_remove_all(office_address,
                                          "\\."),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address,
                                          "Ste", "Suite"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address,
                                          "St", "Street"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Rd", "Road"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Dr", "Drive"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address,
                                          "\\b(\\w{1,2})\\b",
                                          \(x) str_to_upper(x)),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Street", "St"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Road", "Rd"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Drive", "Dr"),
         office_address = str_replace_all(office_address, "Suite", "Ste"),
         clinician_title = str_remove_all(clinician_title, "\\.")
         )
tigercensus <- clean_df(tigercensus_raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-clean-dfs

departments <- read_csv(departments, "../../Clean-Data/departments.csv")
determinants <- read_csv(determinants, "../../Clean-Data/determinants.csv")
diagnosis <- read_csv(diagnosis, "../../Clean-Data/diagnosis.csv")
encounters <- read_csv(encounters, "../../Clean-Data/encounters.csv")
patients <- read_csv(patients, "../../Clean-Data/patients.csv")
providers <- read_csv(providers, "../../Clean-Data/providers.csv")
tigercensus <- read_csv(tigercensus, "../../Clean-Data/tigercensus.csv")
```
